items.source: Transient properties can be used in constructor creation/factory methods, however they will use Java default values. We highly recommend using SpEL expressions through @Value(…) to provide a meaningful value.
items.translation: 瞬态属性可以在构造函数创建/工厂方法中使用，但它们将使用 Java 默认值。我们强烈建议使用通过 @Value(…) 使用 SpEL 表达式来提供有意义的值。

items.source: Excluding properties from the persistence mechanism is separate from Java's transient keyword that serves the purpose of excluding properties from being serialized through Java Serialization.
items.translation: 将属性排除在持久化机制之外，与 Java 的 `<code>transient`关键字是独立的；后者用于防止属性通过 Java 序列化进行序列化。

items.source: Marks a field to be transient for the mapping framework. Thus, the property will not be persisted.
items.translation: 标记该字段为映射框架的瞬态字段。因此，该属性不会被持久化。
